teaser.en: Convulsions were blamed on a bird called *pungu*, and this aromatic shrub was said to drive it away.
teaser.sw: Degedege ililaumiwa kwa ndege aitwaye *pungu*, na kichaka hiki chenye harufu kilisemekana kumfukuza.
teaser.dg: Atu akala anaamini kukala nyuni inarehwa ni nyama wa mapha aihwaye *pungu*, na chitsaka hichi chenye arufu nono chakala nkugombwa kukala chinamuinga.

summary.en: *Muurusa pungu* is an aromatic shrub of the coastal bushland. It is used to cure convulsions, which are believed to be caused by a bird called *pungu*.
summary.sw: *Muurusa pungu* ni kichaka chenye harufu cha nyika ya vichaka ya pwani. Hutumika kutibu degedege, ambayo huaminika kusababishwa na ndege aitwaye *pungu*.
summary.dg: *Muurusa pungu* ni chitsaka chenye arufu nono chinachomera weruni pwani. Nkuhumirwa kuphoza nyuni, ambayo atu anaamini kukala inarehwa ni nyama wa mapha aihwaye *pungu*.

about.en: *Muurusa pungu* is an aromatic shrub of the mint family, with leaves in opposite pairs that release a scent when crushed.
about.sw: *Muurusa pungu* ni kichaka chenye harufu cha familia ya minanaa, chenye majani yaliyokaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana ambayo hutoa harufu yakipondwa.
about.dg: *Muurusa pungu* ni chitsaka chenye arufu nono cha jamii ya *mint*. Makodzage ganamera mairi-mairi ganalolana, na gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu.

where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani.

uses.en: It is used to cure convulsions.

culture.en: The name means 'scare off *pungu*'. *Pungu* is a bird believed to cause convulsions, and this plant is believed to drive it away. Convulsions in Digo belief are often tied to birds: the 'rib' convulsions treated by *mbavubavu* are called *nyuni wa mbavu*, *nyuni* meaning bird.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'fukuza *pungu*'. *Pungu* ni ndege anayeaminika kusababisha degedege, na mmea huu huaminika kumfukuza. Katika imani za Kidigo, degedege mara nyingi huhusishwa na ndege: degedege ya 'mbavu' inayotibiwa kwa *mbavubavu* huitwa *nyuni wa mbavu*, *nyuni* likiwa na maana ya ndege.
culture.dg: Dzina rina mana ya 'kuinga *pungu*'. *Pungu* ni nyama wa mapha ambaye atu anaamini kukala anareha nyuni, na mmea uhu nkuaminika kukala unamuinga. Kpwa imani ya Adigo, nyuni mara nyinji zinahusiana na nyama a mapha: nyuni za mbavu zinazophozwa ni *mbavubavu* zinaihwa *nyuni wa mbavu*, na *nyuni* rina mana ya nyama wa mapha.

names.en: The Digo name is *muurusa pungu*, which Duruma shares. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Premna hildebrandtii*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *muurusa pungu*, ambalo linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Premna hildebrandtii*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *muurusa pungu*, na Aduruma piya anarihumira. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Premna hildebrandtii*.

reason.en: Premna chrysoclada, same genus, also used against convulsions
reason.sw: Premna chrysoclada, wa jenasi ile ile, nao pia hutumika dhidi ya degedege
reason.dg: *Mvuma* (*Premna chrysoclada*), jenasi mwenga, na piya nkuhumirwa kpwa nyuni.

reason.en: Aromatic shrub of the same mint family
reason.sw: Kichaka chenye harufu cha familia ile ile ya mnanaa
reason.dg: *Mtserere*, chitsaka chanjina chenye arufu nono cha jamii mwenga ya *mint*.
